tasks.rationale: Typed environment configuration parsing distinguishes unset, empty, false, zero, enums, and numeric bounds within one principal repair locus.
HMAC canonicalization must coordinate repeated and empty query fields, exact percent encoding, UTF-8, ordered duplicate headers, path and body identity, and verification consistency.
A bounded byte-range parser and resolver combines suffix, open-ended, malformed, and unsatisfiable cases with several interacting boundary rules.
CLI, environment, config, and default precedence spans loader and runtime boundaries while preserving explicit false and zero values.
A versioned model, encoder, and decoder must agree on validation, round trips, and canonical bytes across module contracts.
Persisted v1 to v2 migration coordinates readers, writers, and migration with backward reads, v2 writes, future-version rejection, and idempotency.
A local acquire, use, and release lifecycle must handle exactly-once cleanup, failure cleanup, and closed-state behavior with deterministic fake resources.
Incremental NDJSON decoding tracks chunk, UTF-8, framing, record-number, and size-limit state across multiple feed operations.
Ordered transactional mutations combine rollback, journals, idempotency, conflict handling, and the requirement to leave no partial effects.
New-format parsing may use legacy fallback for the intended absence condition, while malformed input and unrelated failures must remain visible.
Temporary write, replace, and cleanup behavior must survive deterministic filesystem faults and retry or error paths without leaving bad state.
Fresh, stale, and expired cache states interact with conditional validation, stale-if-error fallback, validator preservation, protocol errors, and timing.
